label: Google DNS
description: A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT and CNAME records. Email queries send only the domain.

label: Certificate Transparency
description: Public certificates and observed subdomains from crt.sh; recorded names may be historical.

label: DomainsDB
description: Search registered domain names containing the supplied domain.

label: IPQuery
description: Approximate IP location, ISP, ASN and VPN/proxy/Tor classifications.

label: Shodan InternetDB
description: Previously observed ports, hostnames and possible CVEs; no active scan.
free: Free for noncommercial use; no key

label: RIPEstat
description: Routing prefix and announcing ASNs, or ASN holder and announcement status.

label: PeeringDB
description: Public network name, website, peering policy and traffic information by AS number.

label: IPinfo Lite
description: Country, continent and ASN details using the free Lite endpoint.

label: Wayback Machine
description: Find the closest available archived snapshot without submitting a new capture.

label: Arquivo.pt
description: Search preserved web pages or archived versions of a URL.

label: Library of Congress
description: Search public historical documents, collections and reference material.

label: Wikidata
description: Search public entities and source descriptions; results are candidate matches.

label: GitLab
description: Exact public username matches on GitLab.com.

label: Hacker News
description: Public account age, karma, biography and submission count.

label: Bluesky
description: Public profile by full handle or username.bsky.social.

label: YouTube
description: Public channel details and statistics by @handle or UC channel ID; one quota unit.
free: Free daily quota; API key required

label: IGN France addresses
description: French address and place matches with coordinates from the Geoplateforme.

label: Zippopotam.us
description: Postal-code places and coordinates. Enter a country code and postcode, e.g. FR 63130.

label: French companies
description: Official French company search by name, SIREN or SIRET; includes registered office.

label: GLEIF
description: Global Legal Entity Identifier records by company name or exact LEI.

label: Disposable email domain
description: Kickbox disposable-domain classification. Sends only the domain; does not verify a mailbox exists.

label: Veriphone
description: Standard phone validation, original carrier, line type and country. Use an international number.

label: Hunter domain search
description: Public business email addresses and their published source links for a domain.
free: Free plan with limited credits; API key required

label: urlscan.io
description: Search existing public scan reports only. Does not submit a URL for scanning.
free: Small public quota; optional free-account key

label: AbuseIPDB
description: Existing community abuse reports and IP reputation; never submits reports.
free: Free account quota; API key required

label: VirusTotal
description: Existing domain, URL, IP or file-hash reports only. No file uploads or scan submissions.

label: AlienVault OTX
description: Existing public threat-indicator summaries and pulse counts.

label: NIST NVD
description: Official CVE description, severity and reference links for one CVE ID.

label: CIRCL Vulnerability Lookup
description: Public CVE records and vendor descriptions from CIRCL.

label: FIRST EPSS
description: Daily model estimate of exploitation probability for a CVE, with score date and percentile.

label: Bitcoin / mempool.space
description: Public Bitcoin address transaction counts and confirmed/unconfirmed amounts in satoshis.
